collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A newly married couple must choose where to live: build a new hut, or move in with family.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) are newly married and need a place to live. (subject)'s family has room in their big hut and would love to have them. (friend) would very much prefer a hut of their own, where nobody's grandmother asks what they are cooking. What should they do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: Half the village turns out to help build the new hut. It is small and a little crooked, and the roof leaks in one corner. (subject) and (friend) love it completely. (subject)'s grandmother visits every day anyway and asks what they are cooking.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: They move in with (subject)'s family. It is crowded and loud, and (friend) learns more about (subject)'s childhood than (friend.he/she) ever wanted to. After a year, they build their own hut, right next door.
